verdict.rationale: Paxos documents rule-based orchestrations that trigger automatically when bank transfers arrive and convert fiat to stablecoin without further calls (paxos-docs-41, paxos-docs-8). It also offers an automatic stablecoin-to-fiat conversion option for payments (paxos-docs-13), with webhook events reporting orchestration status as it changes (paxos-docs-26). These are narrow, pre-defined financial-flow automations rather than a general facility for users to build their own background automations. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation or scheduling, documented setup and configuration of orchestration rules beyond mint/redeem flows, agent-oriented autonomous task support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
